assertions: The response routes to the gene-annotation sub-skill for identifier-centered Ensembl work.
The response uses gget.search("ace2", species="homo_sapiens", limit=5) to discover the Ensembl ID as documented in the gene-annotation fast path.
The response uses gget.info(id, ncbi=False, pdb=False) to inspect object_type, canonical_transcript, and biotype.
The response uses gget.seq(id, translate=True) for the UniProt protein sequence and describes the return as a FASTA-line Python list.
The response does not direct the user to the original gget source repository checkout.
